description.value: Studio 58 is Langara College's nationally recognized professional theatre arts conservatory, founded in 1965 and named after the room number of its original theatre space. The program presents four full-length and two indie-style productions annually, all open to the public and reviewed by local press, with professional directors and designers on every production. It offers relaxed-performance options for accessibility-conscious audiences and is a five-minute walk from the Canada Line's Langara-49th Ave Station.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Studio 58 is an active public theatre at Langara College, with a current season and Spring 2026 graduates referenced, so confirmed open. The 'Your Visit' subpage explicitly mentions 'All-Gender Washrooms' under Accessibility, confirming washrooms. It also notes 'The concession is cash only,' confirming food/concession on site. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, racks, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: No bike parking confirmed on website or in OSM tags; required criterion unmet.
This is a college theatre program rather than a standalone attraction; audience visits are production-dependent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Studio 58 is a legitimate public attraction (college professional theatre) and cycling-accessible via the Canada Line, but it lacks confirmed bike parking — a required criterion — and its appeal is limited to those catching a specific production rather than a general cycling stop. Worth including only if the directory covers performing arts venues.
enrichment_extras.notes: The concession stand is described as cash only. The theatre uses general seating and does not admit latecomers, which may matter to cyclists on flexible itineraries.

Café or food on site.detail: Your Visit page notes 'The concession is cash only,' confirming a concession stand is available

wow_evidence: Nationally recognized theatre conservatory with public professional-grade productions — show-conditional.
blurb: Langara's acclaimed theatre school; public productions each season.
